command:
set -euo pipefail
export DISPLAY=:0
PROD=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo PRODUCTION_PID=$PROD
base=9390
idx=0
for mode in app plain newwindow; do
  idx=$((idx+1)); port=$((base+idx)); tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-launch-${mode}.XXXXXX)
  case $mode in
    app) tailarg='--app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' ;;
    plain) tailarg='http://127.0.0.1:8788/' ;;
    newwindow) tailarg='--new-window http://127.0.0.1:8788/' ;;
  esac
  echo "=== MODE=$mode PORT=$port ==="
  setsid bash -lc "exec /opt/google/chrome/chrome --no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage --disable-web-security --remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1 --remote-debugging-port=$port --remote-allow-origins='*' --user-data-dir='$tmp/profile' --window-size=746,449 --window-position=0,0 $tailarg" >"$tmp/stdout" 2>"$tmp/stderr" & pid=$!
  echo PID=$pid
  for i in $(seq 1 60); do curl -fsS --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:$port/json/list >"$tmp/list.json" 2>/dev/null && break || true; sleep .1; done
  sleep 1
  echo ALIVE_1S=$(kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null && echo yes || echo no)
  echo LIST_1S; curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:$port/json/list || true; echo
  sleep 2
  echo ALIVE_3S=$(kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null && echo yes || echo no)
  echo LIST_3S; curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:$port/json/list || true; echo
  echo STDERR; tail -50 "$tmp/stderr" || true
  if kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; then kill -TERM -$pid 2>/dev/null || kill -TERM $pid 2>/dev/null || true; sleep .5; kill -KILL -$pid 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  rm -rf "$tmp"
  sleep .5
done
POST=$(pgrep -fo '/opt/google/chrome/chrome --app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' || true)
echo PRODUCTION_POST=$POST
test "$PROD" = "$POST"
echo VISIBLE_LAUNCH_AB_COMPLETE
